login.text: Sign in to Jellyfin in this browser to discover your year in music, movies and series.

error.adminOnly: Only administrators can see other users' recaps.

empty.title: Nothing to unwrap… yet
empty.text: No plays found for {year}. JellyWrapped has been recording what you listen to and watch since {since}: play a movie, a series or an album, and come back later!

intro.text: Here is your {year} on Jellyfin: the music, movies and series that made it.
intro.hint: Tap the right side of the screen to continue.

total.days: That's {days} days non-stop, spread over {activeDays} of activity and {items}.
total.estimates: Some movies and episodes, watched before JellyWrapped was installed, are estimated.

music.firstTrack: Your very first track of the year: {name}, on {date}.

actor.text: Starring in {n} of your movies this year.

binge.title: {n} episodes in a single day
binge.text: On {date}, {name} just wouldn't let you go.

server.leadFirst: Out of {n} active users, you are
server.leadTop: Out of {n} active users, you are in the
server.firstText: Nobody spent more time on Jellyfin than you this year.

share.note: Anyone with this link can see this recap, frozen as of today, as long as your server is reachable from the Internet.
share.downloadSlide: Save this slide as an image
share.title: My JellyWrapped {year}

binge-watcher: One episode? No: the whole season. The "next episode" button holds no secrets for you.
night-owl: More than a third of your time between 10 PM and 5 AM. The quiet of the night is your moment.
early-bird: You press play before your first coffee. Respect.
explorer: Over 100 different artists: your ears just can't sit still.
music-lover: Music first, everything else later. Your headphones deserve a holiday.
cinephile: Movies are your playground. Lights off, volume up.
series-addict: Series took up most of your year. You know the opening credits by heart.
weekend-warrior: Saturday and Sunday are sacred: couch and Jellyfin.
eclectic: A bit of everything, plenty of good stuff: you won't be put in a box.

inject.bannerText: Your artists, movies and series of the year at a glance.

settings.intro: Each user's yearly recap is available at
settings.injected: The "My Wrapped" link is added to the Jellyfin menu for all users.
settings.notInjected: The File Transformation plugin was not detected: share the address above with your users, or add it to the "menuLinks" of jellyfin-web's config.json.
settings.minAudio: Minimum listening time for a track (seconds)
settings.minAudioHelp: Below this, the track counts as skipped and is not recorded.
settings.minVideo: Minimum watching time for a video (seconds)
settings.estimatesHelp: Movies and episodes marked as played this year, but watched before the plugin was installed, are counted once, for their full length.
settings.comparisonHelp: Shows a ranking ("top 10% of the server") when at least 3 users are active. No names are shown.
settings.sharingHelp: Each user can create a link, visible without an account, to a frozen copy of their recap. Turning this off disables every link.
settings.webLink: Add "My Wrapped" to the Jellyfin menu
settings.webLinkHelp: Requires the File Transformation plugin. Applied at the next restart.
settings.showBanner: Announce the recap on the home page
settings.showBannerHelp: A "Your JellyWrapped is ready" banner is shown during the period below; each user can hide it. Requires the File Transformation plugin.
settings.bannerWraps: The period spans New Year: after 1 January, the banner announces the recap of the year that just ended.
settings.bannerSameYear: The banner announces the recap of the current year.
settings.importHelp: If the Playback Reporting plugin is installed, its history from before JellyWrapped can be imported (duplicates are skipped).
settings.importDone: {imported} plays imported out of {total} (plays already known, recorded after the installation, or of deleted items are skipped).
settings.importFailed: Failed: is the Playback Reporting plugin installed?

users.title: Users' Wrapped
users.help: "View Wrapped" opens the user's full recap in a new tab, exactly as they see it.
